blocks.heading: Start From Your Situation, Not Your Branch

items.text: The same lane looks different depending on where you stand today.
A graduate with a gap year needs a fixed step.
This is the cheapest time to test a lane.
The order follows how far income can realistically grow with skill and proof, not prestige or exam difficulty.
Technical consulting, freelancing, design services, estimation, testing or automation work sold to small firms.
The largest hiring lane for engineers of every branch, from service companies to product firms and startups.

blocks.heading: Four Questions for Choosing a Lane

items.text: The four questions narrows two shortlisted lanes to one.
Field and plant work, desk analysis, client calls, or long study.
Family income, EMI, loans, dependents, city, and how long you can go without earning.

blocks.heading: First Short Test Before You Commit

items.text: Run a short test in each of your two shortlisted lanes, at your own pace.
Build and deploy one small project that solves a problem you have seen.
Pick one public dataset from your own branch, ask one real question, answer it in a spreadsheet or SQL, and write a one-page note with the chart and what you would tell a manager.
A topper video for GATE, an MBA success story, a startup post: each shows the survivor.
Proof built in one lane usually transfers to the next: a clean project write-up helps in software, data, product and consulting alike.
Sample the subject through NPTEL, university open material and official documentation first.
Start by choosing two lanes from the table, write down the first test for each, and put the GATE and ESE dates in your calendar if the government lane is on your list.
A stronger next move is often adjacent, not dramatic: it builds on the branch knowledge and work you already have.

blocks.heading: Government, PSU and Defence-Research: the Live Calendar
rows: GATE 2027 (IIT Madras)
Opens M.Tech and many PSU technical rounds
Registration from 2 September 2026; regular window closes 5 October 2026; extended window with late fee to 12 October 2026. Exams on 6-7, 13-14 and 20-21 February 2027; result 19 March 2027.
UPSC Engineering Services (ESE) 2027
Civil, mechanical, electrical, and electronics and telecom engineers; group A and B technical services

Notified 16 September 2026 with 480 vacancies (civil 219, mechanical 91, electrical 77, E&T 93); applications to 6 October 2026; prelims 31 January 2027; mains 18 June 2027. Age 21 to 30 on 1 January 2027, with category relaxations.
SSC Junior Engineer 2026
Degree or diploma holders in civil, mechanical, electrical, and related posts

About 1,748 posts per published summaries of the notice; applications closed 22 September 2026, so this cycle has passed. Paper I is tentatively October to November 2026 and Paper II in December, dates still to be confirmed. Level 6 pay of Rs 35,400 to Rs 1,12,400. Paper I is qualifying and the merit list uses Paper II.
ISRO Scientist/Engineer 'SC'
B.E./B.Tech in first class with at least 65 percent or CGPA 6.84 out of 10

Applications ran 27 August to 16 September 2026, so this cycle has closed. ISRO lists its computer-based test for 19 October 2026, followed by an interview. Published summaries put the vacancies at 175, in electronics, mechanical and computer science only, with no relaxation in the 65 percent bar. The next cycle is the one to plan for.
DRDO RAC Scientist 'B'
Engineering degree plus a valid GATE score in the matching paper

Advertisement 156 offered 152 posts and accepted GATE 2023 to 2025 scores. GATE scores shortlist candidates 1 to 10, and final merit is 80 percent GATE and 20 percent interview. Dates change every cycle, so check rac.gov.in for the current advertisement.
Army Technical Graduate Course (TGC 145)
Engineering graduates and final-year students who want a permanent commission in the Army

About 30 tentative vacancies; applications 30 September to 29 October 2026 on joinindianarmy.nic.in. No written exam: shortlisting by degree marks, then an SSB interview and medical. Training at the Indian Military Academy from July 2027. Confirm eligibility on the official notice.

blocks.heading: Skill Portfolio That Opens High-Income Options
rows: Software and IT
GitHub with real commits, one deployed project, a clear README, code review or open-source contribution.
Data, AI and product roles
A case study with screenshots and outcome notes, a dashboard, an SQL analysis and a written recommendation.
Consulting and own work
One paid or referenced project, a simple service menu, a testimonial you were given, and a before-and-after result.
Core engineering
Drawing sets, calculations, site reports, PLC or BIM models, and internship notes with what you handled.
MBA
A business case from real work, a process improvement note, a clear target function and a cost comparison.
M.Tech, MS abroad and research
Project report, literature summary, lab or simulation work, and a specific target research area.
